observation.visible_scene: A background of vertical, fan-like light beams shining downwards from the top center, meeting a layer of white, billowing vapor or clouds at the bottom of the frame.
visible_changes: The white cloud/vapor layer at the bottom steadily rises and expands throughout the sequence.
In the initial frames, the vapor layer is lower, allowing the light beams to reach further down clearly.
As the sequence progresses, the vapor layer becomes thicker and taller, gradually obscuring the lower portions of the light beams.
The texture of the vapor shifts continuously, billowing and swirling as it ascends.
The light beams themselves remain static in position and intensity, serving as a fixed background element.
outside_clip_unknowns: The source of the light beams and the vapor is not visible.
The environment surrounding these elements is unknown.
The ultimate height or density the vapor will reach is unknown.
uncertain_details: Whether the white material is smoke, steam, or a stylized cloud effect is not definitively clear, though it behaves like rising vapor.
The camera appears static, but slight movements cannot be entirely ruled out given the changing background.
